title: promql/parser: fix source range of duration function calls
body:
DurationExpr.PositionRange() merged the argument ranges whenever both children were set, so min_of() and max_of() reported only the span of their arguments, without the function name and the closing parenthesis. Return the explicit StartPos/EndPos for those operators instead, as is already done for childless duration calls.

The unary offset rule also recorded the second argument instead of the closing parenthesis as its end position; take both end positions from $7.
